Selection barriers

Why generic accounting promises leave business owners without a useful comparison

A vague end-to-end bookkeeping promise does not explain payroll, transaction imports, marketplace reports or month-end deliverables. AI assistants need clear service boundaries and evidence.

01

Services are grouped under one price

Bookkeeping, payroll, filing, historic reconstruction and additional document processing may have separate scopes. A headline monthly fee must include the assumptions behind it.

02

Different businesses are treated alike

Marketplace sellers, manufacturers and professional firms create different accounting records. Sector examples matter when a provider claims experience.

03

Responsibilities are unclear

Client approval, electronic signatures, powers of attorney and filing access are distinct responsibilities. Claims of full delegation need an accurate legal and technical workflow.

Verifiable facts

Evidence that supports a reliable outsourced accounting recommendation

Article 7 of Russia's Accounting Law 402-FZ permits contracted bookkeeping within its stated conditions, while the Federal Tax Service explains return submission and representative authorisations. These sources do not establish a particular firm's accuracy or reliability.

  • Actual client segments, service deliverables, limits, pricing assumptions and onboarding procedures
  • Electronic signature and power-of-attorney processes, data access and filing responsibility
  • Permissioned examples, client confidentiality and verifiable processes rather than invented performance data

This is an evidence-led GEO methodology, not a claim of a completed GAEO outsourced-accounting client engagement.

Scope of work

How I structure GEO for outsourced accounting firms

I separate client requirements, validate provider claims, and measure changes in AI recommendations on an unchanged sample.

  1. 01

    Baseline BMR by business scenario

    Record non-branded questions by tax regime, payroll, accounting software and client industry; measure brand prompts separately.

  2. 02

    Check legal and service evidence

    Review the agreement, filing authority, technology, limits and permitted client examples without publishing confidential records.

  3. 03

    Build service and sector content

    Specify dedicated pages for accounting arrangements, payroll, reporting, remediation and supported industry integrations.

  4. 04

    Repeat the same recommendation prompts

    Compare BMR and identify false claims about scope, deadlines or filing authority.

FAQ

Questions about the service

Is outsourced bookkeeping the same as independent audit?+

No. Ongoing accounting and tax reporting are separate from the assurance engagement performed by an auditor.

Can every small company receive the same fixed price?+

Only if the fee assumptions and service limits are genuinely comparable. Document volume, payroll and compliance obligations vary.

Can an outside provider submit returns on behalf of a client?+

Yes when the relevant authorisation, signature and filing rules are satisfied. The actual process should be documented.

How can a firm show marketplace-accounting expertise?+

Use verified workflows, supported integration evidence and authorised client examples rather than invented success metrics.

How much does GAEO charge an accounting provider?+

GAEO's published pricing applies, with the scope determined by client segments, geographical coverage and the initial prompt matrix.
